detail: Full summary: Workflow design lesson (not a twining bug): agent() returns null both when a verifier refutes-by-dying and when it genuinely refutes, so a quota exhaustion silently converted unverified findings into 'refuted'. Score null distinctly from false, or a dead fleet reads as a clean bill of health.
